articuno-freeze-dry.name: Freeze-Dry
articuno-freeze-dry.description: Bond skill: a flash-freeze up to 3 hexes away (Power 65) that Freezes for 1 turn.

articuno-aurora-veil.name: Aurora Veil
articuno-aurora-veil.description: Bond skill: a shimmering aurora over itself and adjacent allies: Fortified for 2 turns.

articuno-tailwind.name: Tailwind
articuno-tailwind.description: Bond skill: an icy gale: itself and allies within 2 hexes are Hasted for 2 turns.

articuno-snow-cloak.name: Snow Cloak
articuno-snow-cloak.description: Hides in drifting snow: takes 15% less damage.

articuno-lingering-chill.name: Ice Body
articuno-lingering-chill.description: Heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

articuno-powder-snow.name: Powder Snow
articuno-powder-snow.description: New skill: powdery snow over a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 40), Slowing 1 turn.

articuno-mind-reader.name: Mind Reader
articuno-mind-reader.description: New skill: reads a foe up to 2 hexes away, leaving it Marked for 2 turns.

articuno-glacial-grace.name: Glacial Grace
articuno-glacial-grace.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

articuno-frost-plumage.name: Frost Plumage
articuno-frost-plumage.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

articuno-icy-wind.name: Icy Wind
articuno-icy-wind.description: New skill: a freezing wind along a 2-hex line (Power 45) that Slows for 2 turns.

articuno-hail.name: Hail
articuno-hail.description: New skill: a hailstorm on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 35).

articuno-crystal-wings.name: Crystal Wings
articuno-crystal-wings.description: Its wings of ice: its Ice moves deal 25% more damage.

articuno-endless-winter.name: Mist
articuno-endless-winter.description: Wrapped in mist: sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

articuno-hurricane.name: Hurricane
articuno-hurricane.description: New skill: a howling storm at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 80).

articuno-frost-breath.name: Frost Breath
articuno-frost-breath.description: New skill: always-critical icy breath up to 2 hexes away (Power 55); Exposed 1 turn.

articuno-lofty-glide.name: Lofty Glide
articuno-lofty-glide.description: Glides away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

articuno-brittle-frost.name: Brittle Frost
articuno-brittle-frost.description: Deals 20% more damage to Slowed foes.

articuno-sheer-cold.name: Sheer Cold
articuno-sheer-cold.description: New skill: absolute-zero cold at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95); Frozen 1 turn.

articuno-sky-attack.name: Sky Attack
articuno-sky-attack.description: New skill: dives from the sky onto a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95).

articuno-diamond-dust.name: Diamond Dust
articuno-diamond-dust.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes carrying any status.

articuno-frost-armor.name: Cold Front
articuno-frost-armor.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes at full HP.

articuno-freezing-legend.name: Freezing Legend
articuno-freezing-legend.description: Capstone. Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer; deals 25% more damage to Frozen foes.

articuno-eternal-winter.name: Eternal Winter
articuno-eternal-winter.description: Capstone. Its ranged moves reach 1 hex farther; foes it statused pass that status on when they faint.
